How to split a bill

  1. Enter the bill amount before tax and tip.
  2. Add the tax rate and choose a tip. Pick whether tip is calculated before or after tax.
  3. Set the number of people. Each share updates instantly.

Splitting a monthly cost instead? Try the split rent calculator, or use the split expenses calculator when different people paid for different things.

Example: dinner for 3

A meal is $86.00 before tax. With 8% tax ($6.88) and an 18% tip on the pre-tax amount ($15.48), the total is $108.36. Split three ways, each person pays $36.12.

Frequently asked questions

How do I split a bill with tax and tip?

Enter the pre-tax subtotal, the tax rate, and the tip percentage. The calculator adds tax and tip, then divides the total by the number of people and shows each share.

Should I tip on the pre-tax or post-tax amount?

Both are common. Many people tip on the pre-tax subtotal because tax is not a service charge. Use the toggle to switch the tip base and compare.

How do I split money between friends fairly?

For a shared meal, an even split is simplest. When people pay for different things or one person covers everything, use the split expenses calculator to see who owes whom.

How is the split cost rounded?

Totals rarely divide evenly. This calculator assigns the leftover cents to individual people so the shares always add up to the exact total.

Is my data saved?

No. Calculations run in your browser and nothing is stored or uploaded.
